evidence_items.explanation: The benchmark reports severe limitations in exploring unfamiliar environments and planning effective actions. Its score measures action efficiency relative to human baselines; below 1% must not be described as the percentage of tasks solved.

evidence_items.explanation: This substantial verified result qualifies the blanket claim of historically poor performance on new situations. It establishes success on novel static puzzles, not reliable transfer to arbitrary unfamiliar domains or military strategy.

unresolved_gaps: Neither benchmark directly measures forecasting or planning in geopolitical conflicts.
ARC-AGI-2 success does not establish that its task family was absent from training; the ARC-AGI-3 report discusses this distinction.
